entry.name: jit.phys.6dof
entry.digest: A six degrees of freedom constraint in a physics world
entry.description: The jit.phys.6dof allows for linear and angular constraints of any of the three axes. Each axis can be either locked, free or limited. If only a single body is bound, it is constrained to a point in world space.

attributes.name: springdamp_ang
attributes.digest: Angular spring motor damping
attributes.description: Set the angular spring motor damping for each axis (default = 1 1 1).

attributes.name: springdamp_lin
attributes.digest: Linear spring motor damping

attributes.name: springeq_lin
attributes.digest: Linear spring motor equilibrium point

attributes.name: springstiff_ang

attributes.name: springstiff_lin
attributes.digest: Linear spring motor stiffness
attributes.description: Set the linear spring motor stiffness for each axis (default = 0 0 0).

attributes.name: strength
attributes.digest: Constraint strength value
attributes.description: Set the constraint strength (default = 0.2). Determines what proportion of the joint error will be fixed each simulation step. Values between 0.1 and 0.8 are recommended.

attributes.name: stretch
attributes.digest: Constraint stretch value
attributes.description: Set the constraint stretch (default = 0.0). Setting to a positive value allows forces acting on rigid bodies to violate the constraint by an amount proportional to the stretch value.

messages.description: Removes any current forces and returns the attached objects to their original position.
